newsitem.title: USA: Ricoh wins patent infringe suit vs Nashua.
newsitem.headline: Ricoh wins patent infringe suit vs Nashua.

text.p: Ricoh Co Ltd and its U.S. subsidiaries Ricoh Corp and Ricoh Electronics Inc said on Wednesday that they have won a federal patent infringement verdict against Nashua Corp.

Following a two week trial in federal court in New Hampshire, U.S. District Judge Steven McAuliffe ruled for Ricoh against Nashua Corp, prohibiting Nashua from manufacturing, using or selling copier toner cartridges that infringe a Ricoh patent, the company said.
Judge McAuliffe held that Nashua's toner cartridges for use in Ricoh model FT5000 and FT6750 copiers infringe Ricoh's patent, the company said.
It said McAuliffe will conduct further proceedings to determine the amount of damages that Nashua must pay to Ricoh based upon Nashua's prior sales of patent-infringing cartridges.
